neighbours.label: a noun naming the group of people a health or research finding is about (dog owners, children, moms of babies)
fire: Studies show that dog owners walk more than people who don't have pets.
In 60 percent of children with asthma, symptoms improve by adolescence.
Researchers found that smokers recover more slowly from surgery.
The trial showed that mothers of premature babies slept less in the first year.
Survey data suggest that night-shift workers have higher rates of diabetes.
Among patients with mild hypertension, the drug lowered pressure within weeks.
The paper reports that teenagers who sleep late score lower on memory tests.
Long-term vegetarians had lower cholesterol than the comparison group.
quiet: Studies show that walking more helps people lose weight over time.
In 60 percent of cases, the symptoms improve by the second year.
Researchers found that the wound heals more slowly after surgery.
The trial showed that sleep was shorter in the first year of the study.
Survey data suggest that rates of diabetes are rising across the country.
In the trial, the drug lowered pressure within weeks.
The paper reports that late bedtimes are linked to lower memory scores.
Cholesterol was lower in the treatment arm than in the comparison arm.
